SELECT A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.COURSE_ID AS courseId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DESCRIPTION AS description, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, A.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, NVL(CH.CHAPTER_TITLE, '미지정') AS chapterTitle, S.SUBMISSION_ID AS submissionId, S.SCORE AS score, S.CONTENT AS submittedContent, S.FILE_ID AS submittedFileId, AT.ORIGINAL_NAME AS submittedFileName FROM ASSIGNMENT A JOIN COURSE C ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COURSE_ID, MIN(CHAPTER_TITLE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CHAPTER_ORDER ASC, CHAPTER_ID ASC) AS CHAPTER_TITLE FROM CHAPTER GROUP BY COURSE_ID ) CH ON CH.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID, SUBMISSION_ID, SCORE, CONTENT, FILE_ID FROM ( SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID, SUBMISSION_ID, SCORE, CONTENT, FILE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID ORDER BY SUBMITTED_DATE DESC, SUBMISSION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) WHERE RN = 1 ) S ON S.ASSIGNMENT_ID = A.ASSIGNMENT_ID LEFT JOIN ATTACHMENT AT ON AT.FILE_ID = S.FILE_ID
( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_MATCH WHERE CT_MATCH.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID AND ( ( UPPER(CT_MATCH.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('DEPT', 'DEPARTMENT', '부서') AND CT_MATCH.TARGET_VALUE = #{departmentId} ) OR ( UPPER(CT_MATCH.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('POS', 'POSITION', '직급') AND CT_MATCH.TARGET_VALUE = #{positionId} ) ) ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_SPEC WHERE CT_SPEC.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID AND UPPER(CT_SPEC.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('DEPT', 'DEPARTMENT', '부서', 'POS', 'POSITION', '직급') ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_TARGET CT_ALL WHERE CT_ALL.COURSE_ID = A.COURSE_ID AND UPPER(CT_ALL.TARGET_TYPE) IN ('ALL', '전체') ) ) )
AND ( A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY A.DUE_DATE ASC, C.COURSE_TITLE ASC, A.ASSIGNMENT_ID ASC
ORDER BY C.COURSE_TITLE ASC, A.DUE_DATE ASC, A.ASSIGNMENT_ID ASC

SELECT GREATEST( NVL((SELECT MAX(FILE_ID) + 1 FROM ATTACHMENT), 1), SEQ_ANO.NEXTVAL ) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ATTACHMENT ( FILE_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, CHANGED_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_SIZE, TYPE, VIDEO_DURATION, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, UPLOAD_DATE ) VALUES ( #{fileId}, #{originalName}, #{changedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{type}, #{videoDuration}, #{memberId}, #{status}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT SUBMISSION_ID AS submissionId, FILE_ID AS fileId FROM ( SELECT SUBMISSION_ID, FILE_ID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUBMITTED_DATE DESC, SUBMISSION_ID DESC) AS RN FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION WHERE ASSIGNMENT_ID = #{assignmentId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) WHERE RN = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT GREATEST( NVL((SELECT MAX(SUBMISSION_ID) + 1 FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION), 1), SEQ_ASNO.NEXTVAL ) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION ( SUBMISSION_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, CONTENT, FILE_ID, SUBMITTED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{submissionId}, #{assignmentId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{fileId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION SET CONTENT = #{content}, FILE_ID = #{fileId}, SCORE = NULL, SUBMITTED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE SUBMISSION_ID = #{submissionId}
